_about: The STALKER maps' bushes rustle (the owner, 2026-11-14: "bushes should have rustling sound just like on normal survarium maps"): each map's leaves within a step's reach of a floor, models/srp/<level>_bushes of pack stalker-bushes@2 (game material foliage_deciduous, as stock's bushes), a collision object of its Team Deathmatch project after the level's own chunks, which Free for All's project is a copy of (ffa-projects-1.json, after this list). cgroup 8, cmask 32: the step's ray (group 30h, mask 8) meets it and plays the foliage step; bullets, grenades, cameras, walkers and dead bodies do not (docs/notes/stalker-maps.md, "Bushes rustle"). expected_files: a project the entry cannot be placed in (its anchor gone) stops the build. Made by scripts/stalker-bushes/make_pack.py --edits.
